scope: The 15 remaining phase-C-tagged rooms on the hall kit: prunksaal, bnf, stgallen, mafra, nypl, bpl, peabody, bodleian, escorial, gabinete, melk, klementinum, vatican, wiblingen, weimar. Each room is generated on the device from data/hall/<id>.json whose measured numbers trace to passing evidence rows and whose estimates name their Commons photo source; every room carries a guided tour and the shared room chrome. St Gall and Bodleian pins keep their frozen /stgall and /scan/firstfolio hrefs while their rooms answer direct links. Rooms ship no baked assets (procedural impostor fallback), so the budget gate accepts an absent dist/rooms/<id>. Spec: docs/specs/build-spec.md
preview: bun run build && bunx vite preview --port 4173
recheck: jq -r '.criteria[]|"\(.id)\t\(.check)"' data/phase-d.json | while IFS=$'\t' read -r id c; do sh -c "$c" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "passing $id" || echo "failing $id"; done

hooks.conventions: Every contract e2e title starts with "d-<criterion>:". Room coordinates are metres in the room's world space, x across the aisle, y up, z along the hall. The 15 room ids are prunksaal, bnf, stgallen, mafra, nypl, bpl, peabody, bodleian, escorial, gabinete, melk, klementinum, vatican, wiblingen, weimar; roomIdsD() in e2e/util-d.ts returns them. The pins of stgallen and bodleian intentionally keep the Phase B hrefs /stgall and /scan/firstolio.
hooks.data-place: inherited from Phase C: "inside" for direct loads of every Phase D room.
hooks.no baked assets: dist/rooms/<id> may be absent for Phase D rooms; the hall kit falls back to a procedural end wall. The budget check passes when the folder is absent.

criteria.what: Data build, Vite build, typecheck and unit tests pass
criteria.check: bun run build >/dev/null && bun run typecheck && bun run test

criteria.what: Hooks and criteria are unchanged since the Phase D freeze commit, contract-owned spec files are untouched, and no contract spec is skipped
criteria.check: b=$(git log -1 --format=%H --grep='^Freeze Phase D') && [ -n "$b" ] && [ "$(git show $b:data/phase-d.json | jq -c '[.hooks,[.criteria[]|del(.status)]]')" = "$(jq -c '[.hooks,[.criteria[]|del(.status)]]' data/phase-d.json)" ] && git diff --quiet $b -- 'e2e/*-d.spec.ts' e2e/util-d.ts && jq -e '.frozen.on|type=="string"' data/phase-d.json >/dev/null && ! rg -q '\.(skip|fixme|only|fail|todo)\(' e2e/*-d.spec.ts e2e/util-d.ts

criteria.what: Phase A, B and C contracts are untouched since the amendment freeze, no old assertion is removed or skipped, the suite lists at least 400 tests, and every Phase C check passes
criteria.check: p=$(git log -1 --format=%H --grep='^Freeze Phase B') && git diff --quiet $p -- data/phase-a.json data/phase-b.json data/phase-c.json && [ -z "$(git diff $p -- e2e | rg '^-[^-].*expect\(')" ] && [ -z "$(git diff $p -- e2e | rg '^\+[^+].*\.(skip|fixme|only)\(')" ] && [ "$(bunx playwright test --list 2>/dev/null | rg -c ' › ')" -ge 400 ] && [ -z "$(jq -r '.criteria[].check' data/phase-c.json | while IFS= read -r x; do sh -c "$x" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo F; done)" ]

criteria.what: All 15 hall files exist and each room manifest builds on the hall kit
criteria.check: for i in prunksaal bnf stgallen mafra nypl bpl peabody bodleian escorial gabinete melk klementinum vatican wiblingen weimar; do test -s data/hall/$i.json || exit 1; jq -e '.kit=="hall"' dist/lib/$i.json >/dev/null || exit 1; done

criteria.what: Each Phase D room shows 3 or more facts, each one a passing row of data/facts.json for that room with the same field, value and source, and every passing fact carries a source
criteria.check: for i in prunksaal bnf stgallen mafra nypl bpl peabody bodleian escorial gabinete melk klementinum vatican wiblingen weimar; do jq -e --arg i $i --slurpfile F data/facts.json '(.facts|length>=3) and all(.facts[]; .lib==$i and (. as $m | $F[0].facts | any(.lib==$m.lib and .field==$m.field and .value==$m.value and .source==$m.source and .status=="passing")))' dist/lib/$i.json >/dev/null || exit 1; done && jq -e 'all(.facts[]; .status!="passing" or ((.source//"")|length>0))' data/facts.json >/dev/null

criteria.what: Every Phase D room param carries one of the 6 bases, every comparandum names its building, and the panel shows the matching label in all 15 rooms
criteria.check: for i in prunksaal bnf stgallen mafra nypl bpl peabody bodleian escorial gabinete melk klementinum vatican wiblingen weimar; do jq -e '(.hall|length>0) and all(.hall[]; (.basis|IN("measured","photo-estimate","excavated","attested","comparandum","invented")) and (.basis!="comparandum" or ((.building//"")|length>0)))' dist/lib/$i.json >/dev/null || exit 1; done && bunx playwright test e2e/estimated-label-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/estimated-label-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-[a-z0-9-]+: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar)' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 15

criteria.what: All 15 rooms credit every photo they were estimated from, each credit with an https link, author and licence
criteria.check: for i in prunksaal bnf stgallen mafra nypl bpl peabody bodleian escorial gabinete melk klementinum vatican wiblingen weimar; do jq -e '(.credits|length>0) and all(.credits[]; (.url|startswith("https://")) and ((.author//"")|length>0) and ((.licence//"")|length>0)) and ([.credits[].url] as $u | all(.hall[]|select(.basis=="photo-estimate"); .src as $s | any($u[]; .==$s)))' dist/lib/$i.json >/dev/null || exit 1; done

criteria.what: Every Phase D room has a guided tour of 3 or more stops; each caption is a fact from the room's own data with its source link; Escape ends it
criteria.check: for i in prunksaal bnf stgallen mafra nypl bpl peabody bodleian escorial gabinete melk klementinum vatican wiblingen weimar; do test -s data/tour/$i.json || exit 1; jq -e '.facts as $f | (.tour.stops|length>=3) and all(.tour.stops[]; .fact>=0 and .fact<($f|length) and (.at|length==3) and (.look|length==3))' dist/lib/$i.json >/dev/null || exit 1; done && bunx playwright test e2e/tour-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/tour-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-[a-z0-9-]+: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar)' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 15

criteria.what: The 13 new pins link to their rooms; the frozen St Gall and Bodleian links stay; every other pin has no link or a site path
criteria.check: jq -e '([.[]|{(.id):.href}]|add) as $h | $h.prunksaal=="/room/prunksaal" and $h.bnf=="/room/bnf" and $h.mafra=="/room/mafra" and $h.nypl=="/room/nypl" and $h.bpl=="/room/bpl" and $h.peabody=="/room/peabody" and $h.escorial=="/room/escorial" and $h.gabinete=="/room/gabinete" and $h.melk=="/room/melk" and $h.klementinum=="/room/klementinum" and $h.vatican=="/room/vatican" and $h.wiblingen=="/room/wiblingen" and $h.weimar=="/room/weimar" and $h.stgallen=="/stgall" and $h.bodleian=="/scan/firstfolio" and all(.[]; .href==null or (.href|startswith("/")))' dist/lib/pins.json >/dev/null

criteria.what: Any baked asset folder a Phase D room ships stays at or under 25 MB; absence is allowed
criteria.check: for i in prunksaal bnf stgallen mafra nypl bpl peabody bodleian escorial gabinete melk klementinum vatican wiblingen weimar; do if test -d dist/rooms/$i; then test $(du -sk dist/rooms/$i | cut -f1) -le 25600 || exit 1; fi; done

criteria.what: Every Phase D room mounts once, ready, with three controls, a spine count equal to its shelves, and a clean console and network
Walking each Phase D room keeps p95 frame time at or under 20 ms and draw calls under 200 on a real GPU
criteria.check: bunx playwright test e2e/frame-time-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/frame-time-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-[a-z0-9-]+: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar)' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 15

criteria.what: Each Phase D room builds its first bay before the door opens, at 1x and 4x CPU
criteria.check: bunx playwright test e2e/room-gen-time-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/room-gen-time-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-room-gen-time: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar) @[14]x' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 30

criteria.what: A cold load of each Phase D room transfers 5 MB or less
criteria.check: bunx playwright test e2e/route-weight-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/route-weight-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-[a-z0-9-]+: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar)' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 15

criteria.what: Every control in the Phase D rooms is named and the evidence and tour toggles work by keyboard alone
criteria.check: bunx playwright test e2e/a11y-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/a11y-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-[a-z0-9-]+: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar)' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 15

criteria.what: At 390 px each Phase D room has no horizontal scroll and the controls reach 44 px
criteria.check: bunx playwright test e2e/mobile-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/mobile-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-[a-z0-9-]+: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar)' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 15

criteria.what: Under reduced motion each Phase D room enters with a fade and then holds pixel-still with no running animations
criteria.check: bunx playwright test e2e/reduced-motion-d.spec.ts && test $(bunx playwright test e2e/reduced-motion-d.spec.ts --list 2>/dev/null | rg -o 'd-[a-z0-9-]+: (prunksaal|bnf|stgallen|mafra|nypl|bpl|peabody|bodleian|escorial|gabinete|melk|klementinum|vatican|wiblingen|weimar)' | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 15
